alert_events_held_silence_idx.name: alert_events_held_silence_idx
alert_events_held_silence_idx.where: "alert_events"."processed_at" IS NULL AND "alert_events"."silence_id" IS NOT NULL

alert_events_kind_matches_type.name: alert_events_kind_matches_type
alert_events_kind_matches_type.value: ("alert_events"."event_type" NOT IN ('instance_pending', 'instance_closed', 'evaluation_failed') OR "alert_events"."kind" = 'state') AND ("alert_events"."event_type" NOT IN ('instance_fired', 'instance_resolved') OR "alert_events"."kind" = 'notifying')
